output.reason: This document amends Article 11 of PP 37/2021. JKP funding now comes only from the central government contribution (0.22%) and a recomposition of the JKK contribution (0.14%). The JKM recomposition of 0.10% that was in the previous version no longer appears, so total JKP funding drops from 0.46% to 0.36%. As a result, the employer-paid JKM premium, which enters a permanent employee's PPh 21 gross income, effectively returns to its full rate (0.30% instead of 0.20%). The JKK risk-group rates after recomposition are restated unchanged (0.10%–1.60%). The rest of the document covers participation requirements, claims, benefits and administration, which do not affect PPh 21.
